item.tib: ma mo sgrab pa'i dbang gi 'phrin las byin brlabs dbang gi rim pa
item.coloph: ces pa'i srid pa rgyal mo'i bka' gtad 'di ni zhu tshang g.yu 'brang phyug mo'i sgrub phug nas zab gter rin po che spyan drangs shing phyis su 'dra yul rten 'brel bstan pa dgon khang rgyud mchod kyi lung bstan/ mkha' 'gro dbang mo'i bka' babs las/ 'dra yul bla grwa thams cad kyis bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas dag par phab cing / yi ge ni g.yung drung dpal bzang gis bgyis pas/ g.yung drung gi bon gyi bstan pa mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/ de ltar ma mo bka' gtad 'di rig 'dzin rnams kyi ma 'ongs don phrin las 'grub pa'i dbang bskur bstan se bon bdag gis bkod pa ste be ro bdag gis gces par bzungs zhu g.yu 'brang phyug mor sbas las 'phro can can dang 'phrad par smon sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya
